ID_BATTLEPASS_CRED_ANNOUNCEMENT_HEADER.Note: Max chars count: 36 This is the most important touchpoint. We want to make sure players know what is happening, and ideally when

ID_BATTLEPASS_CRED_ANNOUNCEMENT_SUB1_DES.Note: FAQ Style answer 1 - we should formulate this clearly: Players PROGRESSION is safe and won't be affected, but Raider Decks will actually be affected by this update, so we want to make sure this isn't a misunderstanding. Ideally we phrase this in a very soft and reassuring way. Maybe even give them something to look forward to. (here I teaser to a more expansive (reward) system). Pls feel free to change "expansive" and "reward system" to whatever fits, but I feel like that way it sounds like something to actually look forward to, rather than just "replacing the system"

ID_BATTLEPASS_CRED_ANNOUNCEMENT_SUB2_HEA.Note: FAQ style header 2 - probably the most pressing question
same but phrased without the "spending" part, because maybe players have other reasons why they have leftovers than just not spending (?)

ID_BATTLEPASS_CRED_ANNOUNCEMENT_SUB2_DES.Note: FAQ answer 2: we want to be clear that Cred will disappear. We want to reassure that we reimburse, but still encourage players to spend Creds as that is the option that leaves them control over what they want to spend it on This is the version without any info on compensation/conversion
